title: Editor E1, slice 4: nine data blocks join the contract
detail: Adopts about, story, stats, offerings, booking, memberships, events, practices and journeys into lib/entity-blocks/contract/ with reads 'live'. Their body is drawn from live rows by the entity's widget on the server; the shared data-section component draws what the operator writes, the eyebrow and title. check:blocks now holds 32 of 41. Left on PROG-E1: nine more data blocks and the binding layer.

verify.note: Fails when an adopted block stops holding the contract.
